text:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — weekly health scan flagged an anomalous spend burst for Quantum Capital on hosted API. Alert: +$6.2k in last 48h vs normal ~+$350. Need quick triage and customer outreach. :warning:

InfraBot: automated alert -> account=quantum-capital, window=48h, delta_cost=+$6,200, rule=hosted_commit_burn_rate, link=https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/hosted-burn

Maria (CS): Quick breakdown from billing query (48h):
```
embeddings: cost $6,300
chat/generation: cost $180
other: $20
```
Seems embeddings job dominated. Not sure if this is expected migration test or misconfigured key.

Logan (CSM): Did we see any scheduled migration run or sandbox export on their account? I can ping their PO.

Maria (CS): I checked their workspace notes — they mentioned a migration on Tue but no volume estimate. Also saw a spike in requests from an IP range that maps to their CI provider. sample request_id: req_9f3b1a

Sam (Eng): Can you paste the request header and model name if available? Also checking whether staging keys were mistakenly used against hosted endpoints.

Maria (CS): Model shows text-embed-003-v2 in logs. Example request snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." 
 -d '{"model":"text-embed-003-v2","input":["...bulk docs..."]}'
```

Sam (Eng): That looks like a bulk embedding run. If they shipped CI that iterates over thousands of docs without batching limits it can balloon quickly. I'll check rate-limit / quota usage and whether the requests came with a dev key pattern.

Leo (Fin): Quick finance check — month commit = $25,000, YTD usage before this spike = $18,100. If spike continues at same pace projected month end = ~$34,300 -> ~+$9.3k over commit. Do we want to auto-bill overage or propose a reserved commit? Need CSM guidance.

Logan (CSM): I'll message the customer now and ask them to pause the job + confirm keys. If this was an accidental run we can offer a one-time credit for clearly accidental dev/test misuse, but escalate if it's part of planned migration (then propose Dedicated or higher commit).

Maria (CS): Created internal ticket CS-9542 for triage and finance ops. Attaching short notes and the billing query.

Sam (Eng): Temp mitigation options: 1) apply a soft per-account embeddings throttle (limit concurrent embedding requests), 2) enable batch-size enforcement on their project, 3) add a short-term quota cap to prevent runaway spend. I can implement 1 & 3 within hours. Which do we want?

Logan (CSM): Do 3) quota cap (soft) + reach out to customer. I'll offer a next-steps call and mention reserved capacity if this workload is recurring.

Leo (Fin): If we apply a soft quota cap, please include an override path for them to request an immediate uplift (CS ticket flow) so we don't block legit production runs. Also log any credits we grant against CS-9542.

Maria (CS): Agreed. Action items:
- Logan: contact Quantum Capital, ask to pause embedding job and confirm intent.
- Sam: apply soft quota cap for embeddings on account, add override path.
- Leo: compute exact overage invoice options and prepare 1-pager for Logan.
- Maria: update CS-9542 with outcomes and flag for next weekly review.

InfraBot: ticket created: CS-9542 (spend-anomaly) -> assignees: Maria, Sam, Logan

Logan (CSM): On it. Will DM update in ~30m. :phone: 

Maria (CS): Thanks team — will post customer response and any changes to billing forecast here. :white_check_mark:
